semantic_roles.background: White canvas with black axes and tick marks.
semantic_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: Saturated dataset colors remain distinguishable under overlap; white bar edges separate adjacent bars.
semantic_roles.roles_and_proportions: Red, navy, and teal identify the three datasets consistently in bars and curves; gray is reserved for the normal-fit legend key.

marker_family.axes_and_scales: Linear residual x-axis with shared frequency y-axis; x tick labels are interval bins.
marker_family.guides_and_grid: No interior grid; full black frame with inward ticks on all sides.
marker_family.marks_and_encoding: Overlaid frequency bars encode bin counts; dashed normal curves encode fitted distribution shape.

annotations_typography.callouts_and_leaders: No callout leaders; distribution parameters are embedded in legend labels.
annotations_typography.placement_and_clearance: Legend occupies the upper-left blank region; panel label sits clear of data in the upper right; rotated bin labels are evenly spaced.
annotations_typography.text_hierarchy: Bold axis titles, compact rotated interval labels, math-styled residual notation, and a large panel label.

canvas_composition.alignment_and_spacing: Shared bins align all three groups; bars are narrowly offset within each bin; generous horizontal margins preserve tails.
canvas_composition.aspect_and_panel_layout: Single wide panel with a dense central histogram field, rotated interval labels along the bottom, upper-left legend, and upper-right panel label.
canvas_composition.visual_hierarchy: Overlaid bars and dashed fit curves are primary; legend and panel label are secondary; axes and interval labels provide quantitative reading.

chart_marks_axes.axes_and_scales: Linear residual x-axis with shared frequency y-axis; x tick labels are interval bins.
chart_marks_axes.guides_and_grid: No interior grid; full black frame with inward ticks on all sides.
chart_marks_axes.marks_and_encoding: Overlaid frequency bars encode bin counts; dashed normal curves encode fitted distribution shape.

connectors.anchors_and_routing: Curves follow the shared residual x-scale and pass through the bar field.
connectors.direction_and_arrowhead: No direction and no arrowheads; curves show distribution summaries.
connectors.geometry: Smooth dashed normal-fit curves overlaid across the histogram bars.
connectors.layering: Curves sit above translucent/solid bars for direct comparison.
connectors.stroke: Thick dashed strokes matching each dataset's bar color.

legend_key.entries_and_encoding: Three filled bar swatches include mu/sigma parameters; one dashed-line key denotes normal fits.
legend_key.frame_treatment: Visible light boxed frame with modest padding.
legend_key.placement: Upper left inside the plotting frame.
legend_key.scope: Global legend for all datasets and the fit-curve convention.

must_match: Three overlaid histogram series with shared residual bins
Frequency/count y-axis rather than density values
Dashed normal-fit curves aligned to each dataset color
Rotated interval labels on the x-axis
Boxed upper-left legend plus upper-right panel label

palette_roles.background: White canvas with black axes and tick marks.
palette_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: Saturated dataset colors remain distinguishable under overlap; white bar edges separate adjacent bars.
palette_roles.roles_and_proportions: Red, navy, and teal identify the three datasets consistently in bars and curves; gray is reserved for the normal-fit legend key.

repetition_structures.count_spacing_rhythm: Uniform bins across the residual range; within-bin bars are offset with small gaps.
repetition_structures.grouping_and_alignment: Each dataset's bars and fit curve share one semantic color and the same bin centers.
repetition_structures.topology: Three repeated histogram series use the same bins and x-domain.
repetition_structures.variation_and_emphasis: Color distinguishes datasets; dashed line style distinguishes fitted curves from observed bars.
